content: Paulo kangughenda kangi ku Mekodonia na ku Uyunani
Mbole yakuyomoleka bhulwa ghwa ku Efeso, Paulo kakiakema papamu bhandu bhoha bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito na kuatengelekeha. Mbole kakialagha na kakighenda ku Mekodonia.
Kakikindila mbande ya milima yila pakiayonjokeha bhandu mwoyo kwa malagho matangalo. Mbole kakihika ku Uyunani,

kweni kakitama myehi mindatu. Pakabheghite mu kulibhika kala kwa mwanja ghwa kughenda ku Silia kwa njila ya lihibha, kaking'amula kukita Akaayahudi bhakibhegha bhangupala kuntendela uhakata, habhu kakilamula kubhuya kwa kukindila njila ya ku Makedonia

Paulo kakilongohana na Sopatilo, mwana ghwa Piliho, kuhuma ku Belea, bhubho kakilongohana na Alistaliko na Sekundo ghwa kuhuma ku Sesalonike, Gayo ghwa kuhuma ku Delibe, Timoteo na Tukiko na Tilofimo ghwa kuhuma ku mbande ya ku Asia.
Bhandu abho bhakitulongola na bhakitulindila kula ku Tuloa.
Peni twenga mbole ya kikubhukubhu kya mangate ya nga kubhikwa linjacha, tukiyingila mu bhwato kuhuma ku Filipi na mbole ya manjubha nhano tukihika ku Tuloa kwene tukitama kwa manjubha saba.
Paulo kanguatyangila kangi bhanhyubhalilite Kilisito bha akwo Tuloa
Hino, linjubha lya ulongohi lya juma, tukikwemukana papamu kwa kya kulyegha hilyo. Paulo kakiyobhela na bhandu mbaka pakilo munu, kiyaha kilabho yake kakihwachila kubhuka.
Mu kyumba kya ligholofa kitubheghite kukibha na mimbamba mitangalo payiyaka.

Paulo pakabheghite mu kulandamiha, nhongolo yumu lihina lyake Eutiko kakitama palidilisha, nhongolo aywo yikintopela muno ng'ono, naywo kakiponeka kuhuma ku ligholofa lya ndatu mbaka pahi. Bhakintola pakabheghite kehwegha.
Paulo kakihuluka pahi, na kakilighonjeha unani ghwa yula nhongolona, kilongela, “Nkotoke kubhegha na bhwaghalili kiyaha kubhegha na ubhumi nkati mwaki.”
Mbole kakihubhuka kangi ku ligholofa, kakilyegha mulyo, kakiyobhela nabho mbaka malabhila putiputi ndo kakibhuka
Bhandu bhakimmuyiha yula nhongolo mbaka ku lubhagha lwabhe pakibha ghwa maha nabho myoyo yabhe yikikeka.
Mwanja kubhuka ku Toloa kughenda ku Mileto
Peni twenga tukiyingila mu bhwato tukilongolela kughenda ku Aso, kwene tukihwacha kuntola Paulo. Paulo kakitulaghila habhu kiyaha ywombe kakibha kangughenda akwo kwa maghulu.
Paulo pakatubhonite ku Aso, kakiyingila mu bhwato na tukighenda papamu ku Mitilene.
Kuhuma akwo tukighendelela kwa njila ya lihibha na kilabho yake tukihika ku Kio. Linjubha lya ubhili tukiyomboka kughenda ku Samo na kilabho yake tukihika ku Mileto.
Paulo kakihwachila kughenda Efeso kwa bhwato ngati kakotoke kukabhalila ku Asia kakibhegha pakilopokeha kuhika ku Yelusalemu yikali na kuyingila linjubha lya kikubhukubhu kya Pentekoste.
Paulo kangualagha aghohi bha ku Efeso
Paulo pakabheghite ku Mileto kakililaghila lilagho ku Efeso kuakema aghohi bha ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalilite Kilisito ngati bhakwongane naywo.
Bhala aghohi paahikite kwa ywombe kakiaghombela, “Mwenga mabhene mungumanya kya bhuli nikitama na mwenga kutandila linjubha lya ulongohi panyingilite apa pa Asia.
Mungumanya kya bhula panuntendelite lihengo Bambo kwa utekulo ghoha, kwa mahohi npanimbilila mapungwo na mbyupila na mambingiko ghaandulitwe kubhukana na lukila lwa Akaayahudi.
Mungumanya kukita niking'aka ng'ohe kulandamiha nnando ghwohele gha kuatangatila mwenga, peni nikihunda mu hindandabhanji na mu lubhagha kwa lubhagha.
Nikiakinya bhoha Akaayahudi, na bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Akaayahudi, kukita kila mundu kalipetule ulemwa na bhampilukile Chapanga na kunhyubhalila Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisito.
Hinu, Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kangunongoha ng'ende ku Yelusalemu, na nenga manya ng'obhe kimbala kunbwitukila akwo.
Kinikimanyite ndo kukita Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kangunyimiha mu hitami hyoha kukita hibhopo na himbamanda hingunindila.
Peni hata handa ndahwegha kwa nenga kilibhi ng'obhe, maha nga kuyomola lihengo lyangu lya undumitumi linilikingamite kwa Bambo Yesu, kulandamiha Nhalo ghwa Maha kwa umaha ghwa Chapanga.”
“Ndyanga akwo na akwo munkati yenu bhoha panandamiha Ghubhutwa ghwa Chapanga. Hinu nungumanya kukita kutandila lelo kabhone yumoo ywenu ywakapala kumona kangi.
Lelo nenga nunguaghombela pekupeku kukita handa pakahobha mundu ywohele mu mwenga kahone mundu ghwa kummayila.
Kiyaha niking'aka ng'obhe kubhalandamiha mapalo ghoha gha Chapanga

Mulindakile njimba yenu, na mughingingikihe ngwemuko hyoha yene Nhuki ghwa Chapanga kakiabhika mwenga mubhe alela. Muyihakile ngwemuko ya bhandu bha Kilistito lyene Chapanga kakilihemela kwa mwahi ghwa Mwana ghwake.
Nungumanya kukita mbole ya kubhuka nenga, kabhwa bha kunhitu akalipa bhatabhapukila na bhabhegha na luhungu ng'obhe kwa lumati alwo.
Hata kuhuma mu mwenga bhaabwituka bhandu na kulongela mihalo ya uhwangi ngati amokole kubhahobheha bhandu na kuatenda ahundwa bhabhatughile bhombe.
Hinu, mulindakile, Mulikulungwe kukita mu ngungwa ndatu pakilo na pamuhi nikitotekela kata kuakinya kila mmonga kwa mahohi.”
“Hinu, Nenga nunguabhika, ntame mumabhoko gha Chapanga na mu lilagho lya umaha ghwake, lyene lina makakala gha kubhachenga na kuapegha lipala papamu na bhandu bhangi bha Chapanga.
Nenga nikiyidokolela ng'obhe ngalabha, ebu lihabha, ebu mapinda gha mundu ywoheli,
Mabhene mungumanya kukita ndenda lihengo kwa mabhoko ghangu mwene ngati mokele hilibhi hya kunndangatila mwene na bhala bha mmeghite nabho.

Mu ghoha gha nighatendite nikibhegha nungulaha kukita yingutukwiliha kutenda lihengo lya lihuki twabhene ngati tuhotole kuatangatila bhaabheghite na kya kupala. Patutendite habhu tughakulungwe malagho ghakalongilite mwene Bambo Yesu, ‘Mbaha kubhuha kupitingana kukingama.’ ”
Paulo pakayomolite kuyobhela, kakichutama mayughwa, na kakiyupa papamo nabho bhoha.
Bhoha bhakilila munu na bhakinlagha kwa kunhumbatila na bhakinnonela.
Nnando ghuahyononihite muno ndo kila kya kyaghombite kukita bhaagkibhona kangi ng'obhe ndo bhakilongohana naywo mbaka ku bhwato.
